project.name: digital-twin-edge-cloud-multiscale-performance
project.title: Evaluasi Kinerja Digital Twin Edge–Cloud Multiskala untuk Monitoring Energi dan Okupansi
project.claim_scope: performance evaluation of a monitoring-oriented one-way Digital Twin prototype using deterministic replay derived from one archived physical-sensor trace; field-origin telemetry and replay benchmark results are reported separately

field_sensor_trace.origin: archived telemetry from a physical sensor deployment on a monitored electrical installation
field_sensor_trace.gateway_id_semantics: DeviceID pada workbook mengidentifikasi gateway agregasi Raspberry Pi, bukan jumlah atau identitas unik setiap node sensor fisik.

hardware_roles.ESP32: node akuisisi lapangan untuk suhu, kelembapan, tegangan RMS, arus RMS, dan daya legacy V×I
hardware_roles.Raspberry Pi: gateway agregasi edge; pipeline legacy mencatat ID gateway ini untuk telemetry gabungan dan membawa jalur kamera/okupansi secara terpisah

firmware_sensor_chain.power_calculation: RMS voltage multiplied by RMS current; no power-factor channel in the archived firmware

pln_kwh_reference_comparison.reference: display reading of the PLN kWh meter for the monitored installation
pln_kwh_reference_comparison.interpretation: The comparison supports the field origin and prior practical verification of the sensor deployment, but this repository cannot recompute a calibration error without timestamped start/end meter readings.

legacy_repository.role: historical implementation provenance for the ESP32–Raspberry Pi–cloud and Cesium–Babylon architecture; not the source of current benchmark measurements

data.deadline_basis: operational deadline rounded from the original trace median inter-record gap of 3.5251918 seconds; not the legacy firmware nominal publish interval

replay.sampling: evenly spaced across all replay blocks

energy_integration.interpretation: derived monitoring indicator from the archived V×I signal; field comparison with the PLN kWh meter is researcher-reported, while quantitative interval readings are not stored in this repository

application_lod.detail: macro geospatial context, legacy coordinate, and edge-cloud relation
building-level monitoring summary, energy, occupancy, and routing
detailed indoor 3D scene, sensor state, and occupancy indicator

digital_twin.scale_semantics: three project-defined application LoD levels: LoD-A geospatial site, LoD-B building, and LoD-C indoor 3D; conformance to CityGML, IndoorGML, IFC, or 3D Tiles geometric LoD has not been evaluated

cloud_routing.basis: p99 legacy power in the original historical trace plus software rules for missing, non-finite, invalid electrical, and sub-0.1 A readings

cloud_network_profile.label: configured network emulation; not a measured public cloud
